decisions.what: Created images/.gitkeep as an empty file
decisions.why: Spec allows an empty file to keep the directory tracked

decisions.what: Used Unsplash direct-link URLs (fm=webp / fm=jpg, 400w/800w) for hero and card <picture> elements instead of local images/*.webp/jpg files
decisions.why: images/ is empty, and the spec says to replace placeholder images with Unsplash URLs; Unsplash serves both formats, so the WebP/JPEG fallback still works

decisions.what: Kept favicon and logo pointing at local images/favicon.ico and images/logo.png
Hero image positioned behind content with minimal inline styles (absolute, z-index -2, object-fit cover)
decisions.why: Spec scope covers only index.html; the existing hero uses isolation and a z-index -1 overlay, so this places the photo beneath the overlay without editing styles.css

decisions.what: Added images to program cards and achievement cards with lazy loading, width/height, sizes and descriptive alt text
decisions.why: Spec asks for picture elements on program cards and other sections

decisions.what: Added an 'Image Management' section to README after the existing image guidelines
decisions.why: Spec requests sourcing, tools, dimensions, WebP, alt text, 200KB limit and slow-connection testing guidance
